name: graphgoblin
description: Run, design, and inspect GraphGoblin agent loops from a Codex session.

interface.shortDescription: Run and design GraphGoblin agent loops
interface.longDescription: Registers the GraphGoblin MCP server (loop discovery, runs, waiting, input, signals, event logs, and threads) and ships three skills: $run-loop starts a loop and reports its result, $design-loop drafts and validates a loop definition, and $inspect-run summarises what a run did.
defaultPrompt: Use $run-loop to run the nightly-triage loop.
Use $design-loop to draft a loop that reviews a pull request until the tests pass.
Use $inspect-run to explain what the last run did.
